subject: MoonBay takeover plan and steward nominations
messages:
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Sophie Lang <sophie@moonbay.io>, Alex Ruiz <alex.ruiz@moonbay.io>
Date: 2026-05-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MoonBay post-sign: implementation kickoff & ownership

Team —

Thanks again — MoonBay signed last week for Redwood Dedicated (3x A100 equivalent, VPC) with the 12-month commit. High-level asks from the commercial follow-up:

- Go-live target: Aug 2, 2026 (customer expects data migration weekend Jul 30–Aug 1)
- Must run within their US-only VPC; KMS integration required for keys
- Data retention & audit logs: 7 years
- Procurement will finalize SOW and PO next week (cc’d Sophie + Alex)

Attached: MoonBay_SOW_v1.pdf (stated scope + acceptance criteria) and a rough network diagram.

Action items I need from CS/Implementation:
1) Nominate primary Success owner and Implementation lead for this account (point people to be shared with Sophie).
2) Confirm any red flags on the SOW (security, latency targets, staffing) — we have an elevated SLA request for <100ms p95 on inference for the production endpoint.
3) Suggest a 30/60/90 play outline so we can share with the customer in the kickoff.

Monica/Tessa — can you own the customer-facing kickoff and nominate an implementation steward by EOD Thursday? Ben — pinged you for infra constraints. Karthik — flagging for any approval/credit asks.

Thanks,
David Kim
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: MoonBay_SOW_v1.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)]
[Attachment: moonbay_vpc_network_diagram.png (PNG, 380KB)]

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Sophie Lang <sophie@moonbay.io>, Alex Ruiz <alex.ruiz@moonbay.io>
Date: 2026-05-19T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MoonBay post-sign: implementation kickoff & ownership

David —

Happy to take point for the kickoff. Quick responses and proposed owners below:

- Customer-facing Success lead: Monica Patel (me) — primary contact for adoption and acceptance.
- Implementation lead (technical PM): Ben Carter — will own runbook, infra provisioning, and staging.
- Escalation (ops/exec): Tessa Morgan — for SLA/priority decisions.

Preliminary 30/60/90 outline (high level):
- 0–30d: account intake, environment prep (VPC peering, KMS onboarding), staging deployment, smoke tests
- 30–60d: pilot traffic, performance tuning, KV cache baseline, quantization/p95 latency tuning
- 60–90d: production cutover, migration window (Jul 30–Aug 1), hypercare 30d post-go-live

Risks/Notes:
- SLA ask (<100ms p95) may require dedicated inference pipeline and aggressive batching configs; Ben, can you validate if 3x A100 equiv is adequate for their expected qps?
- We need network ACL details from MoonBay (subnet ranges + firewall egress rules) — Sophie, can procurement include that in the PO?

I’ll send a kickoff agenda and proposed invite times once Ben confirms infra constraints.

—Monica
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
[Signature: Monica Patel | +1 415-555-0123]

From: Sophie Lang <sophie@moonbay.io>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-19T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MoonBay post-sign: implementation kickoff & ownership

Thanks Monica — quick clarifications from procurement side: 

- PO & SOW: procurement expects to sign the SOW by 2026-05-26 and issue the PO 5 business days after that.
- Network details: we can share subnet ranges and firewall egress requirements; will attach to the PO.
- Go-live: Aug 2 is a target but the real constraint is our data migration weekend. We need guaranteed blackout window (no schema changes) July 30–Aug 1.

Also, FYI we have an internal security request: they want to run an external pen test of the dedicated endpoint during the staging phase (week of Jun 21). We can schedule but will need a brief (1–2 page) description of the public-facing interfaces for their security team.

Appreciate the owner nominations — Sophie (MoonBay)
Procurement Team: procure@moonbay.io
[Attachment: moonbay_network_ranges.csv (CSV, 2KB)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-20T09:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MoonBay post-sign: implementation kickoff & ownership

Team —

Thanks for the quick coord. A couple operational notes from my side:

1) If we need to meet the <100ms p95 SLA for production, we have flexibility to approve a one-time onboarding credit (to offset extra warm capacity and an accelerated support strike team). I approve pursuing that if Ben validates the capacity gap.
2) Please annotate any security exceptions raised during the pen test window and escalate to Security for a formal review — do not ship risky mitigations without an approved compensating control.

Monica/Tessa — please loop me into the kickoff invite when scheduled. If you believe we need a short exec sync with MoonBay leadership before the cutover, flag that in the kickoff notes.

Karthik Iyer
VP, Go-to-Market | Redwood Inference

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Sophie Lang <sophie@moonbay.io>, Alex Ruiz <alex.ruiz@moonbay.io>
Date: 2026-05-21T15:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MoonBay post-sign: implementation kickoff & ownership

All —

Thanks everyone. Confirming final owner roster and next steps:

Owners: 
- Customer Success Lead: Monica Patel (monica.patel@redwood.com)
- Implementation Lead: Ben Carter (ben.carter@redwood.com)
- Executive Escalation: Tessa Morgan (tessa.morgan@redwood.com)

Next steps (I’ll take these on):
- Create and send a 45-minute kickoff agenda + Zoom invite for the week of May 25 (goal: align staging dates and pen-test window).
- Ben to validate infra capacity and provide a short note by Fri (2026-05-23) confirming whether 3x A100 equiv meets their p95 SLA or if we recommend a temporary scale-up.
- David to coordinate SOW/PO finalization with Sophie and share updated DocuSign link when ready.
- Monica to prepare a 1–2 page security interface summary for the customer pen test team (due Jun 18).

Ben — if you need me to waive any internal gating to accelerate provisioning, call it out. Karthik — noted on potential onboarding credit; we’ll surface if needed.

Tessa Morgan
Head of Customer Success Operations | Redwood Inference
[Meeting: Kickoff draft to follow]
